description: This file defines API route handlers for managing notes in a web application. It uses FastAPI to create endpoints for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, and interacts with a repository module for data persistence.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data and returns the created note.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes( skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of records to skip for pagination"), limit: int = Query(100, ge=1, le=1000, description="Maximum number of records to return"), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of notes.

methods.name: Note get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to retrieve"), )
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: Note replace_note( payload: NoteCreate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to replace"), )
methods.description: Replaces an existing note with new data, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: Note update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to update"), )
methods.description: Partially updates fields of an existing note, raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: None delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to delete"), )
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID, raises 404 if not found.
